summary.headline: Wisconsin gas averages $4.07/gal
summary.blurb: Regular gas is averaging $4.07 a gallon across Wisconsin as of November 3, 2026, according to GasBuddy. AAA figures put the statewide average 28¢ lower than a week ago, 2¢ higher than a month ago, and $1.44 higher than a year ago. Drivers are finding the lowest metro average in Eau Claire ($3.83) and the highest in Mosinee ($4.42).
